- serviceTask("Record overpayment as credit") - reason: Payment more than invoice amount
- serviceTask("Hold payment as unmatched") - reason: No matching invoice found

- serviceTask("Update accounts receivable aging report") - reason: Track payment status
- serviceTask("Trigger automatic follow-up for overdue invoices") - reason: Ensure timely collection
